classification.summary: Tenerife Padel Retreats is a proven, high-frequency winter organiser: monthly 5-night padel camps with dated winter editions (Dec 8-13 2025, Jan 11-16, Feb 1-6, Mar 1-6, Apr 5-10 2026) and a stated 130+ participants across 8 retreats from Nov 2025 to May 2026 (post DT8fYEEDQtn, DXY0_YijXsf). Groups of about 12-16 match the villa's capacity. However, the product is budget (EUR 368 per person for 6 days, accommodation sold separately as a 4-star hotel add-on) and anchored to a padel club, so a luxury private villa is a poor commercial fit unless padel courts near Porto Rafti can be bundled. Commercial risk is medium: volume is real but price point is low. Recommend at most a scouting stay to test a 'Athens padel week' concept; do not prioritise over premium organisers.
